snp3.3:1.2: ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā sāvatthiyaṃ viharati jetavane anāthapiṇḍikassa ārāme.
snp3.3:2.1: catūhi bhikkhave aṅgehi samannāgatā vācā subhāsitā hoti na dubbhāsitā anavajjā ca ananuvajjā ca viññūnaṃ
snp3.3:2.3: idha subhāsitaññeva bhāsati no dubbhāsitaṃ dhammaññeva bhāsati no adhammaṃ piyaññeva bhāsati no appiyaṃ saccaññeva bhāsati no alikaṃ.
snp3.3:2.4: imehi kho bhikkhave catūhi aṅgehi samannāgatā vācā subhāsitā hoti na dubbhāsitā anavajjā ca ananuvajjā ca viññūnanti.
snp3.3:2.6: idaṃ vatvāna sugato athāparaṃ etadavoca satthā
snp3.3:3.2: dhammaṃ bhaṇe na adhammaṃ taṃ dutiyaṃ
snp3.3:3.3: piyaṃ bhaṇe na appiyaṃ taṃ tatiyaṃ
snp3.3:4.1: atha kho āyasmā vaṅgīso uṭṭhāyāsanā ekaṃsaṃ cīvaraṃ katvā yena bhagavā tenañjalimpaṇāmetvā bhagavantaṃ etadavoca
snp3.3:4.2: paṭibhāti maṃ bhagavā paṭibhāti maṃ sugatāti.
snp3.3:4.4: atha kho āyasmā vaṅgīso sammukhā sāruppāhi gāthāhi abhitthavi
